success_contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, and leave it running.
required_behaviors: QEMU must be launched in the background
The guest console must be exposed over telnet on port 6665
The service must be ready before completion is reported
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or command success as sufficient without confirming telnet readiness
Stopping after launch without verifying the login prompt is reachable
Using a different port or non-telnet access path
verification_plan: Locate the ISO and determine a QEMU invocation that maps the guest console to telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the QEMU launch command and background process start
Receipt showing successful telnet readiness on 127.0.0.1:6665 with the login prompt visible

items: Inspect available files/tools to locate /app/alpine.iso and QEMU availability
Launch QEMU with telnet-accessible console on 127.0.0.1:6665 in the background
